title: Minimax Extrapolation of Event-Study Effects beyond Disappearing Not-Yet-Treated Controls
banked_reason: CAP/BLOCK: the final bounded retry refuted the proposed unit-normalized Pareto interpolation and left the support-aware intermediate-budget frontier unmatched, so the fixed FIELD headline is unproved.
gap_reasons: The FIELD problem remains because P1/P2 and P5 are not matching at intermediate deviation budgets.
P6/P7 refute the particular unit-normalized conjecture, but they do not supply the missing support-aware frontier.

The surviving exact-modulus MSE and honest-length results are generic Gaussian-modulus consequences, and the finite Pareto program plus boundary counterexample do not by themselves meet the fixed FIELD novelty floor.
proof_attempt_summary: The run derived the exact nested score covariance and reduced the problem to a finite Pareto energy program. A final non-identical retry made the four-block transport explicit and proved both endpoint and dual bounds, but it also refuted the proposed unit-normalized interpolation at m=k. The support-aware intermediate-deviation frontier remains unmatched, so no closed calendar-rate phase diagram or field-level headline was established.
tldr: A fixed-cohort repeated-cross-section event study induces an exact Gaussian score experiment with shrinking not-yet-treated pools and nested shared-baseline dependence. The calendar ATT is Holder-smooth, while centered cohort deviations are bounded but unrestricted. The kernel computes the DiD exhaustion modulus, proves a dimension-free lift of terminal boundary bumps, and matches total measurable affine procedures with global minimax MSE and honest-length lower bounds. The corrected information accumulation is quadratic in comparison depth, yielding stochastic scale \(\sigma\sqrt{T/N}/k\) and homogeneous Holder bandwidth denominator \(2\beta+2\). A matched-date-block experiment supplies a fully finite-sample calibration rather than a novelty claim.
gap: Staggered-DiD methods stop where valid comparisons disappear or conduct inference for already identified effects. Optimal-recovery results begin after the Gaussian operator and class are supplied. Neither literature prices disappearing controls, cohort composition, and smooth calendar extrapolation jointly.
fill: The project derives the covariance, proves the lift, computes the corrected uniform phase envelope, constructs total infimum-approaching estimators and honest intervals, and matches their global lower bounds.
